---
title: The Lantern Keeper
author: Ada Marsh
---

# Chapter 1: The Orchard

For my sister, who kept the lamp lit.

“Every road is a long one at night.” — an old saying

The orchard behind the house had seven trees, and each one had a name that only the family used.

The harbour was quiet before the boats went out, and the gulls stood on the posts like people waiting for a bus.

Nell walked the length of the sea wall twice, counting the lamps, and then sat on the steps to watch the tide come in.

# Chapter 2: The Well

The well in the yard had been dry for years, but the bucket still hung over it on its rope.

Her uncle kept the lighthouse on the point, and every evening he climbed the hundred and twelve steps with a can of oil.

The storm came up from the south in the afternoon, grey at first and then the colour of slate.
